value.a: /moreabout is the sibling by READER, not an overlap: moreabout's reader is CC, its store is the learning trees, every invocation writes a moreabout_signal back; tellmeabout's reader is Akien, its stores are the record stores, its feedback is his verdicts — collapsing them would lose the 'just for me' half of his ask

presentation is VERBATIM by rule: the record's own words, its address, and the act it waits on — the moment it summarizes it becomes a translation wearing the source's clothes, for the one reader who most needs the source
ambiguity is refused by listing, never guessed — one discipline, third tenant (recordverdict, the orient floor, now this)

findings live at trace_root() (~/.cairn/devices/learning_block/0/traces/), NOT CairnCommons/learning/records — that store holds VERDICT records; the survey premise said otherwise and the build corrected it before it mattered

once this ticket AND the charter both exist, the bare token 'tellmeabout' is legitimately ambiguous (ticket + charter) and the resolver refuses by listing — ambiguity grows with the corpus and the refuse-by-listing rule absorbs it; the fuller tokens still resolve

the PROVED crossing taught two fill-when-needed fixes recorded here: owning_intention became the bare address once the charter existed (the cast-day prose annotation could not resolve as an owner), and the charter gained gated_by:['CC'] at the clearance gate's own OwnerUnresolvable refusal — same path the compiler, harbor_master and import_sieve walked
